name: notch receptor 4
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: NOTCH4 encodes neurogenic locus notch homolog protein 4 [Cleaved into: Notch 4 extracellular truncation; Notch 4 intracellular domain]. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and signaling receptor activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
